title: Three queries that distinguish the model from its picture
weightPolicy: Queries are unweighted. A hop counts one recorded connection; it is not a cost, probability, time or causal effect.

queries.title: What connects to the new station?
queries.finding: The new station has three incoming connections and no outgoing connection. Ignoring direction reveals its three neighbours, but does not create three supported outward routes.

queries.title: Can the recorded arrows connect new track to the town council?
queries.finding: A two-hop recorded route passes from new track through carbon sustainability to the town council. No directed return route exists. The undirected projection allows the return in two hops; that is a change in the question, not new project evidence.

queries.title: How many records connect new trains to the safety board?
queries.finding: Two directed records carry conflicting weights, 0.7 and 0.9. The display draws one connection and retains both records in its inspector. A simple graph on its own loses their multiplicity.

representations.label: Flat drawing
representations.change: Only node positions and layer grouping on screen change; the same data, arrows and inspector remain.

representations.label: Simple directed analysis
representations.change: Parallel records collapse to one ordered pair; source weights are excluded from analysis.

representations.label: Undirected neighbourhood projection
representations.change: Directions and parallel multiplicity are discarded; node layer labels remain available.
